g.text: Workflow 3 — Mentor Application, Admin Approval & Account Activation
Public Application → Acknowledgment Email → Admin Evaluation → Existing-User Resolution → 24h Setup Token → Password Hash → Profile Activation
EXECUTION PIPELINE: 8 SEQUENTIAL STAGES FROM CANDIDATE APPLICATION TO LIVE BOOKINGS
Rejects if expired or usedAt !== null
1. APPLICATION SUBMISSION, ADMIN CONTROLLER & REVIEW ROUTES
• Access: Public candidate access; no session required to apply
Enforces fullName, email, phone, domain, expertise, currentRole, experienceYears, sessionTypes
• Duplicate Conflict Guard: Checks for active pending applications for this email
• Auth Guard: Enforces pathway_admin_session cookie and verifies user.role === 'ADMIN'
• Idempotency Check: If already approved, returns existing mentor record safely without side effects
• Audit Logging: Writes MENTOR_APPLICATION_APPROVED event with admin credentials
• Input Parameters: { token: string, password: string }
• Verification: Hashes token with SHA-256 and finds unconsumed record in db.passwordSetupToken
• Password Strength Guard: Enforces minimum 8 characters; hashes via bcrypt (12 salt rounds)
• Atomicity: Updates user.passwordHash, sets usedAt = now, and creates new session in one operation
• Response: Returns HTTP 200 with user entity and active mentor session token
• PENDING: Candidate submitted form; reference ID assigned; no account yet.
• UNDER_REVIEW: Admin actively investigating LinkedIn/GitHub; candidate informed of progress.
2. IDENTITY RESOLUTION & DATA MODELS (USER, MENTOR, APPLICATION)
The Problem: What if the approved mentor was already a registered candidate?
Blindly creating a new User record would crash with duplicate email error or orphan prior applications.
Case A: User Already Exists in db.user
• Elevates user role: db.user.update({ where: { id }, data: { role: 'MENTOR' } })
• Preserves candidate profile, education, project links, and job applications without data loss.
• If candidate already has passwordHash, avoids forcing password reset unless explicitly requested.
Case B: Completely New Mentor Applicant
• Creates new User: db.user.create({ data: { role: 'MENTOR', mustChangePassword: true, ... } })
• Initializes base profile with headline, phone, location, and years of experience.
• Triggers password setup token creation so the applicant can set their initial password.
expertise String[] (Array of specialized mentoring skills)
startingPrice Float (Minimum mentorship hourly rate in INR)
reviewedBy String? (Admin user name who approved/rejected)
internalAdminNotes String? (Confidential notes recorded by reviewers)
INDEX ARCHITECTURE: @@unique([email]) on User; @@unique([referenceId]) on MentorApplication;
@@index([status, domain]) on Mentor enables lightning-fast candidate filtering without full table scans.
private static readonly EXPIRY_HOURS = 24; (Expires in exactly 24 hours)
Before issuing a new token, marks all prior tokens for this userId as usedAt: new Date().
Only the SHA-256 hash (tokenHash) is stored in MongoDB. If DB is breached, tokens cannot be forged.
✓ SINGLE-USE ATOMICITY: Verification fails if tokenRecord.usedAt !== null or now > expiresAt.
• Content: Displays reference ID (PM-2026-XXXXX), applicant summary, next steps.
• Content: Congratulations, onboarding guide, and direct button linking to setupUrl.
• Resilient Execution: Wrapped in try/catch; email delivery failure never rolls back approval.
• Public Profile Query: Candidate portal queries where: { status: 'APPROVED', publicProfileEnabled: true }.
• Service Offerings: Displays mentor session types (1:1 Call, Mock Interview, Resume Review) and starting hourly fees.
• Calendar Integration: Mentor sets up weekly availability slots via AvailabilityService.
• Candidate Bookings: Candidates can directly book and confirm mentorship sessions.
Prisma Models: MentorApplication · Mentor · User · PasswordSetupToken · EmailDelivery
✓ 24h Setup Tokens Verified · SHA-256 Hashed in DB · Safe Candidate Role Elevation
